summary.headline: Trines and Sextiles of Planets
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of trines and sextiles involving the Moon and Jupiter, and the Sun and Mars, covering public welfare, charity, commerce, weather, military affairs, coinage, and royal favor. Aristotle is cited regarding negligence in war when the Sun is in Aquarius, with special effects assigned to Mercury’s provinces and the East and Aram.
